From her first movie at the age of 9, violet-eyed Elizabeth Taylor caught the attention of those in Hollywood and beyond.

Over the years, the three-time Oscar winner's off-screen endeavors became more of a focus to the public. While her unwavering AIDS activism and fragrance and jewelry lines were major accomplishments in addition to an already prolific film career, it was Taylor's eight marriages — several to other popular actors, including Richard Burton — that would make bigger headlines.

"I've been lucky all my life. Everything was handed to me: looks, fame, wealth, honors, love." she told Life magazine in 1992. "But I've paid for that luck with disasters. Terrible illnesses, destructive addictions, broken marriages."
